title: KYCIdentityExtractionSchema
description: Strict schema for Know-Your-Customer (KYC) identity verification documents.

full_name.description: Full legal name as printed on the identity document.

dob.description: Individual date of birth in ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format.

expiry_date.description: Document expiration date in ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format, or null if document does not expire.

document_type.description: Standardized category of the identity document.

nationality.description: Citizen country of issuance or nationality.
